_schema.id: stable task identifier, used in result filenames
_schema.category: static method | instance method | abstract method | interface method | field
_schema.member: the member being moved, as Class.member
_schema.source: fully-qualified class the member starts in
_schema.target: fully-qualified class the member should end up in
_schema.family: expected refactoring family (see MOVE_FAMILIES in run_eval.py)
_schema.ide_tool: IntelliJ MCP tool that performs this move, or null when none exists
_schema.referencing_files: files other than the source that reference the member
_schema.verified_type: RefactoringMiner type string observed when the move is applied by hand
_schema.prompt: task text given to the agent; deliberately does not mention any tool

OpenRefine.prompt: In main/src/com/google/refine/util/StringUtils.java, move the static method toString(Object) into com.google.refine.util.ParsingUtilities, and update everything that calls it.

The static method convert(JsonNode) in main/src/com/google/refine/expr/util/JsonValueConverter.java belongs with the other JSON helpers. Move it into com.google.refine.util.JSONUtilities and update its callers.
Move the static method toArray(ArrayNode) from com.google.refine.util.JSONUtilities to com.google.refine.util.ParsingUtilities, keeping all call sites working.

Row.getCellTuple(Project) in main/src/com/google/refine/model/Row.java only builds a CellTuple from the project it is handed. Move the method onto com.google.refine.model.Project so it reads project.getCellTuple(row).

Pool.poolReconCandidates(Recon) in main/src/com/google/refine/util/Pool.java reads almost entirely from the Recon it is given. Move the method onto com.google.refine.model.Recon and update the caller.

computeFeatures(Recon, String) in main/src/com/google/refine/model/recon/StandardReconConfig.java sets features on the Recon it receives rather than using its own state. Move it onto com.google.refine.model.Recon.

The Exporter interface in main/src/com/google/refine/exporters/Exporter.java declares getContentType(). Push that declaration down into its three sub-interfaces (StreamExporter, UrlExporter, WriterExporter) so Exporter itself no longer declares it.
Move the abstract method declaration getType() from com.google.refine.clustering.ClustererConfig to com.google.refine.clustering.Clusterer, keeping the hierarchy consistent.
BinningClusterer and kNNClusterer both declare getJsonRepresentation(), but their shared superclass com.google.refine.clustering.Clusterer does not. Pull that method up into Clusterer.
Push the protected method initializeFromConfig(Project, ClustererConfig) down from com.google.refine.clustering.Clusterer into its two subclasses, BinningClusterer and kNNClusterer.
Move the static field defaultWriter from com.google.refine.util.ParsingUtilities to com.google.refine.util.JSONUtilities, and update everything that reads it.
The instance field judgmentBatchSize on com.google.refine.model.Recon is really a property of the recon statistics. Move it to com.google.refine.model.ReconStats and update its users.
